incident_message: This is Callu with an incident alert. {severity_text} on {service}. {title}.
dtmf_prompt: Press 1 to acknowledge and stop the paging, 2 to pass it to the next person, star to hear this again, or 9 to ask for a video conference. If you do nothing, the next person on the schedule will be called.
ack_confirm: Acknowledged. Nobody else will be called about this.
escalation_confirm: Understood. The next person on the schedule is being called now.
ack_failed: Sorry, the acknowledgement could not be registered. The incident is still open and paging continues. Please acknowledge it in Callu.
escalation_failed: Sorry, the escalation request could not be registered. The incident is still open. Please escalate it in Callu.
invalid_key: That key does nothing here. Press 1 to acknowledge, 2 to pass it on, star to hear the alert again, or 9 for a video conference.
conference_wait: Setting up a video conference for you. Please hold on.
conference_success: The video conference is ready and the link has gone to {count} people. You can join now.
conference_fail: Sorry, the conference could not be created. The incident is still open in Callu.
conference_duplicate: A video conference has already been requested for this incident.
conference_requested: Your request has been recorded and will show on the incident in Callu. This call will now end.
